digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler - binding store and create dispatch
propositions: A crash during create followed by index lag causes recover_pending to unbind a keyless-pending entry (missing from unindexed search), which then allows create_one to dedup-search and miss the same unindexed issue, writing a duplicate Jira issue

The duplicate is prevented only by gating the create on keyless-pendingness within a grace window at the write site (dispatch_one.create_one), not by fixing recover_pending's search alone, because get_jira_key returns None for pending entries and is invisible to the create gate

The fix requires recording search_miss_count on keyless-pending entries, unbinding only after 3+ consecutive misses AND entry age exceeding the grace window (default 3600s per JIRASERVER-70423), and deferring creates while keyless-pending bindings are within that window
The corroborated-miss rule and grace-window deferral must apply to both Cloud and DC vendors because eventual consistency is not DC-specific, and a vendor branch would exercise the safe path least
recover_pending must not count still-pending entries as resolved, so the caller does not treat them as settled
